answer_1.quote: We focus on natural language CoT (N-CoT) ... and program-based CoT (P-CoT) using Python.

answer_4.quote: We perform a human evaluation to qualitatively assess the output... We ask four different annotators to score the reasoning path according to the following criteria, each scored on a scale from 0 to 1. • Logic ... • Naming ... • Compactness ...
